meta_title: SM Mobile Auto Electrician | Car Electrics Manchester
meta_description: SM Mobile Auto Electrician in Manchester. Mobile callouts for car electrical faults, battery issues, and starter repairs. Same-day service across Greater Manchester.
hero_eyebrow: Mobile Auto Electrician — Fast Roadside Diagnosis
hero_subhead: Battery won't start? Lights flickering? We come to you across Manchester and fix most issues on the spot.
services_heading: Complete Mobile Auto Electrical Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From battery replacement to complex alternator diagnostics, we diagnose and repair on-site whenever possible.

services.title: Battery Replacement & Testing
services.desc: Dead battery? We carry spares and fit them on the roadside. Includes full charging system check to ensure your new battery charges properly.

services.title: Starter Motor Repair & Replacement
services.desc: If your car won't turn over, we diagnose the starter and solenoid. Most replacements completed same day with quality parts fitted.

services.title: Alternator & Charging Issues
services.desc: Recharging problems or warning lights? We test your alternator on-site and replace if needed. Covers all vehicle types.

services.title: Lighting Repairs & Upgrades
services.desc: Flickering headlights, failed brake lights, or HID conversion faults. We repair bulbs, ballasts, and wiring to get you road-legal again.

services.title: Fault Code Diagnosis & Clearing
services.desc: Dashboard warning lights puzzling you? Our diagnostic scanner reads fault codes and we fix the underlying cause, not just clear the warning.

services.title: Vehicle Rewiring & Cable Repairs
services.desc: Damaged wiring harnesses, corroded terminals, or shorted circuits. We trace faults and repair or replace sections without removing your whole loom.

about_pullquote: I fix cars properly the first time, so you don't waste money on repeat visits.
about_para_1: SM Mobile Auto Electrician has been diagnosing and repairing car electrical faults across Manchester and Salford for over 12 years. Founded to fill the gap between main dealers (expensive and slow) and cowboys (unqualified and unreliable), we've built a reputation for honest diagnostics and fair pricing. Based in Cheetham Hill, we operate a fully mobile service—no need to tow your car to a workshop.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is the time we spend getting to the root cause rather than replacing parts until something works. We carry spares for the most common failures and can complete many jobs roadside. Customers trust us because we explain what's wrong before we start work, never quote inflated prices, and we're just as happy to advise you to try a cheaper fix first if that's the best solution for your vehicle.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Motorists Say About Us

reviews.text: Called out to a dead battery in Prestwich on a Sunday evening. Turned up within an hour with a replacement and fitted it straightaway. Charged me a fair price and gave me good advice about why it had failed. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been going to dealerships for years and paying through the nose. Found SM after my alternator warning came up. He diagnosed it properly, showed me the fault code, and fixed it for a third of what the dealer quoted. Does what he says and charges honest money.
reviews.author: Patricia H.

reviews.text: My starter motor packed in. Drove round three other local electricians and nobody could come for days. Rang SM in the morning, he was there by afternoon. New starter fitted and working perfectly. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: David K.
